about_the_game:
Welcome to Turning Manor! As the newly hired Quality Control Inspector your job is simple.

Inspect each floor: 

  • Count the glitches

  • Choose the correct door

But this won't be as straight forward as it seems because strange things start happening...

Turning Manor is a first person count the difference psychological horror anomaly game. If you like impossible liminal spaces, feelings of unease and piecing together clues you will likely enjoy this game.

Key Features

  • Collect anomalous events. The Manor will mess with you. From dodging axes to the sounds of someone sneaking up behind you, each attempt will be different.

  • Unlock unique areas. Finishing each wing lets you progress in unlocking new areas to play, each with their own distinct layouts, dangers and challenges.

  • Beginner friendly with an expert challenge. Perfect accuracy is not needed and progress doesn't reset, yet a good accuracy grade is something to be proud of thanks to glitches that increase in difficulty.

  • Mystery to unravel. Collect items and find clues to uncover more about the Manor's inhabitants. Discover the answer to the question: what is going on at Turning Manor?

Developer Note

Sabbatical Games does not use generative AI. We do our best to ensure externally created assets are not AI generated, and to minimize the chance of accidentally including GenAI content we work with a combination of hand crafted, photo scanned and creative commons assets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: intel 8700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX-1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: intel 8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX-2000 series, or RX 6000 series
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to unravel the mysteries of Turning Manor.
